detail: Full summary: memsearch design ideas worth evaluating for Twining: (1) L1→L2→L3 progressive recall (chunk search → section expand → verbatim transcript) run in a forked subagent so intermediate results never pollute main context; (2) transcript anchors for verbatim provenance — Twining has no episodic/session-narrative layer at all; (3) embedding choice backed by a published benchmark.
